roles.title: Software Engineer Intern (AI Automation)
roles.description: Built full-stack dashboards and Python LLM workflows (n8n) that read meeting transcripts and pull out the action items, automating follow-ups. Integrated automations with outside apps through REST APIs, replacing tasks the team did by hand every week. Developing a backend service that turns incoming emails into structured JSON that internal tools can search. Designed checks and a human review step so AI output is accurate before anyone relies on it, and scoped each tool with the coworkers who use it, turning manual processes into automations that save hours each week.

roles.title: Instructional Assistant, DSC 10 (Principles of Data Science)
roles.organization: UC San Diego, Halıcıoğlu Data Science Institute

Contributed to the course's grade report tool, which pulls scores from several sources so students can track their grades. Lead a DSC 10 study group, breaking probability and data science ideas into simple steps.

roles.title: Full Stack Software Developer (Part-time)
roles.organization: UCSD Foundation Interface Lab (Prof. Haijun Xia)
roles.description: Developed a TypeScript AI chatbot for the lab's Meridian app that turns a user's plain request into on-screen UI, and packaged it as its own npm component so other projects can plug it in quickly. Benchmarked AI models on how well they generate UI and used the results to choose the production model. Engineered prompt rules that check what the user is asking for, so the AI skips off-topic or unsafe requests. Wrote unit tests for the app's data binding and UI generation, catching bugs before features reached users, and collaborated with researchers through Git and code reviews.
